'''Oman Dashar''' was a kingdom of the [[Third Age#Free Years|Free Years]]. It was founded after the end of the [[Trolloc Wars]], and was established on parts of the former territories of [[Jaramide]] and [[Safer]]. It was later absorbed by the growing might of [[Artur Hawkwing's Empire]]. The lands it once held are now controlled by [[Arad Doman]].

==Geography==
[[Image:Oman Dashar.png|thumb|right|200px|In red location within the Westlands]]

Oman Dashar was bordered by the [[Mountains of Mist]] in the east, the [[River Akuum]] in the south and the [[River Dhagon]] in the west and north. Its neighbors were [[Abayan]] to the west, [[Indrahar]] to the north, [[Masenashar]] to the east and [[Darmovan]] to the south.

==History==
Extremely little is known of Oman Dashar, due to its small size, beyond that it was conquered by [[Artur Hawkwing]] and made part of his empire. During the subsequent [[War of the Hundred Years]] its lands became part of the kingdom of Arad Doman. The city of [[Katar]] lies just south of the old border of Oman Dashar.
